text: Shifted iOS and Android app releases from monthly to weekly, a 4x faster cadence, shortening lead time and cycle time.
Deployed 3 AI reviewers as an automated guardrail on every PR, enforcing a consistent quality bar and reducing wait time.
Developed a reusable design system with 90 tested components, integrated into 5 services in production.
Shipped enterprise auth panel using AI tools with passkey, edge deployment in 3 environments, and 10+ RBAC roles.
Migrated CI/CD from CircleCI to GitHub Actions, achieving instant, 100% reliable deployments and 80% faster deploys.
Resolved hundreds of lint warnings across four services, raising quality standards and reducing tech debt.
Improved platform performance, cutting load times across all pages by 60% and boosting Homepage LCP by 80%.
Established E2E tests covering 100% sensitive flows in CI/CD, reducing validation time and boosting release confidence.
